responsibility: This file implements the input side of GCC’s generic typed streaming layer used by LTO and related serialization code. It restores primitive values from lto_input_block or bitpack streams, including indexed and nul-terminated strings from the shared string table, variable-length signed and unsigned HOST_WIDE_INT encodings, poly_int/poly_uint coefficients, gcov counts, and physical wide_int/widest_int representations, with consistency checks for section overruns and malformed strings. Its role is the low-level deserialization of scalar and string data, complementing but distinct from higher-level tree or GIMPLE streamers.
